description: Election Commission - Declare that A. K. M. S. S. Athapaththu as a member of the Mahawa P/S
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Mahawa Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for a local authority position, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new member, which falls under election-related matters.
